body:
This is Explaining Superpowers,  and today is Power Copying. 

Power Copying, also known as Ability  Replication, is the ability to copy, steal,  

or recreate the powers and abilities of others. Because Power Copying is such a versatile  

ability, it has many different forms and  limitations. Some users need physical  

contact to copy abilities, while others only  need to see a power once. Certain users can  

perfectly replicate powers with no drawbacks,  while others can only use weakened versions or  

store a limited number of abilities at a time. Users of Power Copying can mimic physical  

abilities, elemental powers, energy manipulation,  regeneration, superhuman strength, and much more. 

Notable users of Power Copying  include Kakashi Hatake from Naruto,  

Chrollo Lucifer from Hunter x Hunter,  and Yuta Okkotsu from Jujutsu Kaisen.  

All of these users are skilled in power  copying, such as Kakashi Hatake, using  

an ability called Sharingan, to copy  over one thousand powers from others. 

This power was recommended by [Lucas Diniz],  so you can also recommend superpowers,  

and I’ll try to explain them. If you want to  see more videos like this, like and subscribe.
